senses.gloss:
Rādha Gautama (‘descendant of Gotama’) is the name of
two teachers in the Vaṃśa Brāhmaṇa.^1
1) Indische Studien, 4, 373, 384.

Rādheya, ‘descendant of Rādhā,’ is the metronymic of a
teacher in the Śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka (vii. 6).
Cf. Keith, Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society, 1908, 372.
